name: Comeuppance
oracle_text: Prevent all damage that would be dealt to you and planeswalkers you control this turn by sources you don't control. If damage from a creature source is prevented this way, Comeuppance deals that much damage to that creature. If damage from a noncreature source is prevented this way, Comeuppance deals that much damage to the source's controller.
blocked_sentences: Prevent all damage that would be dealt to you and planeswalkers you control this turn by sources you don't control.
If damage from a creature source is prevented this way, Comeuppance deals that much damage to that creature.
If damage from a noncreature source is prevented this way, Comeuppance deals that much damage to the source's controller.

needs.what: a this-turn prevention shield over a player AND the planeswalkers that player controls (including ones that enter later this turn), filtered by the damage source's controller ("by sources you don't control")
needs.why_existing_wont_do: prevent_damage shields only a seat and takes no source filter, so it would also prevent damage from your own sources and leaves planeswalkers unprotected; prevent_damage_permanent resolves its objects now (missing planeswalkers that arrive later) and also has no source filter; prevent_combat_damage filters by source but is combat-only and not keyed to the protected player

needs.what: the 615.5 rider must see the source of the prevented damage: a binding for the source object (with its characteristics as it was when the damage was prevented) so the rider can branch on whether it was a creature, deal the amount to that creature, or deal the amount to the source's controller
needs.why_existing_wont_do: prevent_damage's effects rider gets only {"binding": "amount"} and event_player (the protected seat); the DAMAGE_PREVENTED event carries source= but nothing exposes it to the rider, so neither 'that creature' nor 'the source's controller' can be named
